cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
src = open('tests/test_lifecycle.py').read()
old = '''# ---------- inspect ----------'''
new = '''# ---------- atomicity: failures leave high-water marks unchanged ----------
lim = dict(LIM); lim["cells"] = 4
expect("stage cell-reject keeps epoch hw", [
    {"op": "stage", "epoch": 5, "policy": "contains(A,B) allow;"},   # cells > 4 -> reject
    {"op": "stage", "epoch": 5, "policy": "match(A) allow;"},        # same epoch now ok
    {"op": "stage", "epoch": 5, "policy": "match(A) allow;"},        # hw raised -> reject
], [REJ, st(5, [False, True], [[DENY, 1], [DENY, DENY]]), REJ], limits=lim)

lim = dict(LIM); lim["units"] = 1
expect("spawn unit-reject keeps gen hw", [
    {"op": "spawn", "unit": [0, 2, 3], "service": "A"},
    {"op": "spawn", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "service": "A"},   # capacity -> reject
    {"op": "exit", "unit": [0, 2, 3]},
    {"op": "spawn", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "service": "A"},   # gen hw untouched -> ok
], [OK, REJ, OK, OK], limits=lim)

lim = dict(LIM); lim["contexts"] = 1
expect("begin ctx-reject keeps rid hw", [
    {"op": "stage", "epoch": 1, "policy": "contains() allow;"},
    {"op": "commit", "epoch": 1},
    {"op": "spawn", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "service": "A"},
    {"op": "begin", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 7},
    {"op": "begin", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 8},   # capacity -> reject
    {"op": "finish", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 7},
    {"op": "begin", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 8},   # mark 7, rid 8 ok
], [st(1, [True], [[0, 0, 0]]), OK, OK,
    {"ok": True, "epoch": 1, "state": 0}, REJ, {"ok": True, "allow": True},
    {"ok": True, "epoch": 1, "state": 0}], limits=lim)

lim = dict(LIM); lim["packets"] = 1
expect("send pkt-reject keeps stream hw", [
    {"op": "stage", "epoch": 1, "policy": "contains() allow;"},
    {"op": "commit", "epoch": 1},
    {"op": "spawn", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "service": "A"},
    {"op": "begin", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 1},
    {"op": "begin", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 2},
    {"op": "open", "connection": [1, 1]},
    {"op": "send", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 1, "connection": [1, 1], "stream": 9, "destination": "A"},
    {"op": "send", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 2, "connection": [1, 1], "stream": 10, "destination": "A"},  # capacity
    {"op": "close", "connection": [1, 1]},
    {"op": "open", "connection": [1, 2]},
    {"op": "send", "unit": [0, 1, 1], "rid": 2, "connection": [1, 2], "stream": 10, "destination": "A"},  # fresh conn
], [st(1, [True], [[0, 0, 0]]), OK, OK, {"ok": True, "epoch": 1, "state": 0},
    {"ok": True, "epoch": 1, "state": 0}, OK,
    {"ok": True, "wire": wirehex(1, 0, 10, 9, 1)},
    REJ, OK, OK,
    {"ok": True, "wire": wirehex(1, 0, 10, 10, 2)}], limits=lim)

# cells freed by retire become reusable
lim = dict(LIM); lim["cells"] = 3
expect("cells freed by retire", [
    {"op": "stage", "epoch": 1, "policy": "contains() allow;"},
    {"op": "retire", "epoch": 1},          # not resident-removable? not active, 0 refs -> ok
    {"op": "stage", "epoch": 2, "policy": "contains() allow;"},
], [st(1, [True], [[0, 0, 0]]), OK, st(2, [True], [[0, 0, 0]])], limits=lim)

# ---------- inspect ----------'''
assert old in src
src = src.replace(old, new, 1)
